pyramiding_rule: No scaling into positions unless the initial entry has traveled at least +$10.00 in profit and stop-loss is locked at breakeven plus commission.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce a minimum 25-pip initial stop distance on XAUUSD combined with an ATR volatility filter to prevent micro-noise stop hunts.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stops or scale-outs once floating profit crosses +$15.00 to prevent evaporation down to sub-dollar outcomes.
